previous_statement: Pre-application completion of the raw-call record. Using only the component data and bounds of nodes 1.2-1.4, first form the complete def-maincb-raw-call datum, before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. In the branch m>1, record: the Stage-1 tag; the supplied input map w; source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A (the target ambient of the sum-map conclusion); base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; the literal sum map v_old plus v_fresh and its fixed amplifications; target ambient defect epsilon; and d_raw:=D_1*t_1. In the branch m=1, record: the same tag and input map; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper scale; v_fresh with its fixed amplifications; target ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon, the defect parameter already supplied by node 1.3. The definition of a raw call expressly says that recording d_raw asserts no inclusion theorem, so entering D_1*t_1 in the m>1 record before applying the external lemma is data entry, not circular reasoning. The recorded ambient defects epsilon and L*epsilon are at most t_1, and every remaining antecedent is supplied and bounded by nodes 1.2-1.4.
new_statement: Pre-application packaging, with data formation separated from threshold provenance. From nodes 1.2-1.4 form the complete def-maincb-raw-call record before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. If m>1, record the Stage-1 tag; supplied input map w; source C^{m+1}; explicit target corner/ambient A; base scale t_1 and no post-helper datum scale; the complementary target pieces P_old and P_fresh; the literal sum map obtained from v_old and v_fresh through their corner-to-A inclusions and the corresponding fixed amplification family; target-ambient defect epsilon; and d_raw:=D_1*t_1. If m=1, record the same tag and input map; source C^2=C^{m+1}; explicit target corner A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper scale; v_fresh and its fixed amplifications; target-ambient defect L*epsilon; and d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon. Recording d_raw is not circular because def-maincb-raw-call expressly asserts no inclusion theorem. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply the target pieces and all component data and bounds, but they do not supply t_1<=e_1. That inequality comes only from node 1.1 and therefore only under the explicit added premise in node 1.1 that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. Conditional on that premise, the complete record meets every antecedent of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement at scale t_1. This node does not discharge the separate scope obstruction recorded at node 1.1 and does not imply the unconditional root contract.
